attribution: Synapse Hub (Thế Vị @TeeVee98) — Inspired by BMAD-METHOD 6-Direction Elicitation

directions.wrong: Find what is wrong, broken, or inconsistent
directions.missing: Find edge cases, contracts, or invariants that are missing
directions.premise: Challenge unstated assumptions and foundational premises
directions.future: Simulate failures, scale cliffs, and long-term maintenance cost
directions.other-side: Argue the strongest opposing perspective before deciding
directions.simplify: Strip bloat and identify the smallest complete design

methods.name: Red-Team Fault Injection
methods.description: Actively inject null, malformed, and boundary inputs to break assumptions.
methods.form: Three concrete failure payloads with expected vs actual failure mode.

methods.name: Silent Exception Audit
methods.description: Locate try/except blocks or fallbacks that swallow real errors.
methods.form: List of catch blocks and what failure signal each suppresses.

methods.name: Tautology Detector
methods.description: Expose assertions or checks that pass regardless of implementation bugs.
methods.form: Assertions that survive simple mutation plus concrete replacement.

methods.name: Cross-Line Regex & Parser Audit
methods.description: Probe multiline strings, escaping, and unicode inputs against regex rules.
methods.form: Adversarial inputs that bypass pattern guards.

methods.name: Contract Drift Diff
methods.description: Compare documented schemas and CLI flags against actual code signatures.
methods.form: Mismatch table of declared vs implemented fields.

methods.name: 7-Dimension Edge Matrix
methods.description: Check empty, null, boundary N/N+1, duplicate, cancel, RBAC, and concurrency.
methods.form: Checklist of uncovered dimensions with concrete test cases.

methods.name: Downstream Caller Blast Check
methods.description: Identify callers whose defaults, return types, or exit codes could break.
methods.form: Caller impact table with backward-compatibility verdict.

methods.name: Teardown & Idempotency Probe
methods.description: Verify repeated runs leave zero orphan files, locks, or dirty rows.
methods.form: Idempotency invariant and cleanup verification step.

methods.name: Observability & Receipt Audit
methods.description: Confirm every state transition emits inspectable structured telemetry.
methods.form: Missing telemetry fields required for post-mortem triage.

methods.name: Path & Symlink Containment
methods.description: Verify all user-supplied paths and slugs stay strictly inside repo root.
methods.form: Traversal attack inputs and containment check location.

methods.name: First Principles Decomposition
methods.description: Strip inherited habits and re-derive requirements from hard constraints.
methods.form: Core constraints vs inherited conventions that can be dropped.

methods.name: Zero-Context Goldfish Review
methods.description: Read the spec assuming zero tribal knowledge to surface hidden rules.
methods.form: Ambiguous terms requiring deterministic ruling.

methods.name: Inversion Check
methods.description: Ask how to guarantee this design fails, then invert every failure driver.
methods.form: Top 3 guaranteed failure paths and structural blockers.

methods.name: Kill-Before-Build Gate
methods.description: Test whether an existing Hub engine already solves 80% of the request.
methods.form: Overlap map against existing tools/ and net-new delta.

methods.name: Offline-First Determinism Check
methods.description: Question every mandatory network or external daemon dependency.
methods.form: Dependencies replaced by stdlib offline defaults.

methods.name: Pre-Mortem Analysis
methods.description: Assume the rollout failed in 3 months and trace the exact causal chain.
methods.form: Ordered timeline of failure triggers and early warning sensors.

methods.name: Cascading Failure Simulation
methods.description: Break one dependency on purpose and trace blast propagation.
methods.form: Single fault trigger, propagation path, and containment bulkhead.

methods.name: 10x Scale & Concurrency Stress
methods.description: Evaluate lock contention, file sizes, and latency at 10x session volume.
methods.form: Bottleneck hotspot and bounded mitigation.

methods.name: Context Compaction Survival
methods.description: Check what critical state is lost when an agent context window resets.
methods.form: State fields persisted to disk vs ephemeral memory.

methods.name: Schema Evolution Compatibility
methods.description: Test reading v1 artifacts with v2 code and rolling back safely.
methods.form: Forward/backward migration and rollback plan.

methods.name: Steelmanning
methods.description: Build the strongest possible argument for the rejected alternative.
methods.form: Opposing option at full strength and decisive counter-evidence.

methods.name: Devil's Advocate Stance
methods.description: Assign an explicit AGAINST stance to attack the recommended branch.
methods.form: Three high-severity objections the recommended branch must answer.

methods.name: Cross-Family Blind Audit
methods.description: Evaluate outputs anonymized so model/author identity cannot bias judgment.
methods.form: Anonymized comparison matrix and blind ranking.

methods.name: Maintainer Burden Lens
methods.description: Judge the design as an on-call engineer debugging it at 2 AM.
methods.form: Operational pain points and diagnostic simplification.

methods.name: Security Attacker Lens
methods.description: Treat every input file and prompt response as hostile untrusted data.
methods.form: Injection surfaces and sanitization barriers.

methods.name: Lean 7-Rung Subtraction
methods.description: Remove every class, flag, or abstraction not required by a concrete test.
methods.form: Items deleted and net LOC reduction.

methods.name: Single-Responsibility Split
methods.description: Keep modules small and focused without monolithic god-files.
methods.form: Module boundary map with <= 3 files per milestone.

methods.name: Progressive Context Disclosure
methods.description: Load only minimal indices first; fetch details strictly on demand.
methods.form: Token budget before vs after progressive loading.

methods.name: Stdlib Replacement Audit
methods.description: Replace third-party packages with Python standard library equivalents.
methods.form: External dependencies eliminated.

methods.name: Minimal Diff Guard
methods.description: Restrict edits to targeted blocks preserving untouched legacy code.
methods.form: Exact hunk list and zero out-of-scope edits.
